# ankra_organisation_variables (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's variables. The counterpart of `ankra org variables list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_organisation_variables" "all" {}

output "variable_names" {
  value = [for variable in data.ankra_organisation_variables.all.variables : variable.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `variables` (Attributes List) Variables in the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the variable.
- `is_secret` (Boolean) Whether the value is a secret.
- `name` (String) Variable name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value; null for a secret variable.
